_comment: v2 grid: testing reward-to-risk levers (stoploss + roi_multiplier) — the real root cause of Round 1 failure. Round 1 proved EMA/RSI tuning has no effect when avg winner < avg loser.

_grid_rationale.stoploss: Round 1: avg loser ~3.5% with SL=-0.035. Testing tighter cuts (-2.0% to -3.0%) to improve reward:risk.
_grid_rationale.roi_multiplier: Sets the 0-min ROI target. Higher = let winners run more. Testing 6-10% max profit target.
_grid_rationale.ml_threshold: Kept from Round 1. 0.009 gave 65% WR (more trades), 0.011 gave 48% (too few). Testing both.
_grid_rationale.atr_threshold: v5 new: skip flat market entries. 0.002=looser, 0.003=stricter volatility gate.
